name: dark_constraint
refute_if: the visible-only model fails to absorb the dark constraint at K=1 (residual not ~0), OR the unexplained residual at K>=2 does not grow with dark strength, OR it is not separable from the dark_strength=0 null

shape.name: octahedron
shape.dark_constraint: one antipodal brace (0,1) -- a real constraint the observer's model omits
shape.note: the 3 antipodal pairs are the only non-edges of the octahedron, so they are the only places a hidden constraint can live
